_comment: Everything except /api. Two reasons, and the second one is the load-bearing
one: /api is proxied to the dispatch server, which sets its own headers, and
a browser given two Content-Security-Policy headers enforces BOTH. The
password-reset page at /api/auth/reset is server-rendered with an inline
script carrying a per-response nonce — a second policy here that does not
know that nonce would block it, and the reset form would silently stop
Keep this list in step with apps/server/src/headers.ts.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://maps.googleapis.com https://maps.gstatic.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://maps.gstatic.com https://maps.googleapis.com https://*.googleusercontent.com https://images.unsplash.com https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https://maps.googleapis.com https://maps.gstatic.com; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-ancestors 'none'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'self'
geolocation=(self), camera=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()
